summary: Brim hf. engages in the fishing, processing, and marketing of ground fish and pelagic fish in Iceland. The company sells various seafood products that include ground fish, including cod, redfish, saithe, haddock, halibut, and golden salmon; and pelagic fish, such as capelin, herring, mackerel, and blue whiting, as well as fish drying and fish roe. It also operates fishing vessels and processes fish. The company sells its products in Europe, Asia, North America, and Africa. The company was formerly known as HB Grandi hf. and changed its name to Brim hf. in August 2019. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Reykjavík, Iceland.
